title: From Descriptive Richness to Bias: Unveiling the Dark Side of Generative Image Caption Enrichment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using three metrics: Gender error (the rate of incorrect gender predictions in captions), Recall disparity (the average absolute difference in object recall between genders), and LIC (quantifying gender-stereotypical information by comparing the accuracies of two gender classifiers trained on generated versus ground-truth captions).
